scope.baseline_source: Exact source snapshots before this task; the internal scratch Git ref represents those files only.

intent: Replace approved read-only groups with native single-column Descriptions only when at least three independent facts exist; keep one-item current version as text. Preserve all write, permission, draft and recovery behavior, and publish real per-page before/after evidence.

coverage.execution: sequential in the main context under the user AGENTS.md tool mapping; no subagents or external peer
coverage.scope: Exact pre-task snapshots versus final owned changes; all unrelated dirty work excluded. Supplemental HTML, README and retained local static-server source inspected directly.
coverage.validators: empty-batch; no retained current findings required separate validation
limitations: The same context authored and reviewed the change; no independent or cross-model review is claimed.
Screenshots use isolated fixtures and do not establish production deployment or full end-to-end behavior.

peer.coverage: User instructions require serial work in the main context. No external delegation or independent peer was used.
